1.title: Trump downplays AI risks after dire expert warnings and calls to slow development down
1.summary: The US President said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".

2.title: Top Lawmakers Agree A.I.’s Risks Are Rising but Say They Have No Quick Fix
2.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson warned on Sunday of competitive risks from China, and Hakeem Jeffries, the minority leader, said Congress should start regulatory talks this week.

3.title: US congressman swims to safety after his plane is forced to land on a lake
3.summary: The small plane carrying Rep Tom Tiffany had a mechanical issue that forced the pilot to make an emergency landing on a Wisconsin lake.

4.title: Trump doubles down on united Ireland comments on day two of visit
4.summary: The US president was speaking at the Irish Open on Sunday and said "many people agree" with his comments.

5.title: An Election in Sweden Shows Shifting Priorities
5.summary: Sweden votes on Sunday. With various crises easing, center-left politics seem in vogue again, but the far right cannot be discounted.

6.title: Russia struck train near Poland border shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials passed through
6.summary: The former UK PM said "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".
